frame: x along the crank toward the timing end, y left, z up (an inline engine's cylinder axis); origin on the crank axis at the flywheel face of the block
source: tools/cargen/engine_mesh.py from the engine file's own geometry (data/engines/pico_i3_1l0_na.json). Proportions are [AS] rules of thumb (bore pitch 1.12 x bore + 10 mm, deck = stroke / 2 + rod + 0.33 x bore, head and cover heights by valve count, manifolds drawn compact); the bounding box is the generated mesh's own.
